data.display_address: Peninsula Dubai Residences, Jumeirah 2, Jumeirah, Dubai
data.long_description:
H&H Peninsula Residences is a prestigious waterfront development on Jumeirah 2, where life revolves around water, marina views and contemporary design by acclaimed architects. Set around a private marina with landscaped boulevards, this exclusive community blends elegant living, premium experiences and a rich array of on‑site amenities for a refined coastal lifestyle in Dubai.

Features & Amenities:

Prime waterfront & marina access with scenic Arabian Gulf and Dubai Canal views
Infinity swimming pools and sun deck areas
Fully equipped gym and wellness spaces including yoga and spa zones
Private marina with yacht berths and waterfront promenades
Landscaped boulevards and outdoor recreation areas
Boutique retail, cafés and fine dining options within the community
Kids’ play areas and family‑friendly leisure zones
24/7 security, concierge services & covered parking
Direct access to waterfront promenades and walking path
